_comment: Copy this folder, rename it, and edit to create a new face.
name: my_face
_character_comment: Personality goes in character.md next to this file.
_face_base_comment: Uncomment to add a full face/head background image:

eye_left._image_comment: Remove underscore from _image to load a PNG, or omit for procedural

nose._image_comment: Remove underscore from _image to load a nose PNG

_art_notes: All PNGs are optional. Missing ones fall back to procedural drawing.
CANVAS: 800x800px. Export every PNG at full artboard size with transparency.
FILES:
face_base.png  - full face/head background (omit for floating features on black)
eye_left.png   - left eye art, positioned at cx/cy
eye_right.png  - right eye art, positioned at cx/cy
nose.png       - nose art, positioned at nose cx/cy (optional)
mouth_sil.png  - closed mouth (resting state)
mouth_pp.png   - lips pressed (m/b/p sounds)
mouth_aa.png   - wide open (a/aw sounds)
mouth_oo.png   - rounded (oo/ow sounds)
mouth_ee.png   - wide smile (ee/ih sounds)
mouth_ah.png   - relaxed open (uh/er sounds)
POSITIONING (tweak in JSON, no re-export needed):
eye cx/cy      - center point of eye art on canvas
eye scale      - resize eye art (0.5 = half, 2.0 = double)
eye opacity    - transparency (0.0 = invisible, 1.0 = fully opaque)
nose cx/cy     - center point of nose art on canvas
nose scale     - resize nose art
nose opacity   - transparency for nose
mouth offset_x - shift mouth art left/right in pixels
mouth offset_y - shift mouth art up/down (negative = up)
mouth scale    - resize mouth art around anchor point
mouth opacity  - transparency for mouth
anchor_cx/cy   - scale pivot + procedural mouth position
face_base_opacity - transparency for face base image
PROCEDURAL (used when PNGs are missing):
eye_color      - color for procedural triangle eyes
glow_color     - halo glow around procedural shapes
glow_intensity - glow brightness (0=none, 1=normal, 2=intense)
mouth color    - fill color for procedural mouth
mouth style    - 'toothed' or 'rounded'
mouth n_teeth  - tooth count for toothed style (0 for rounded)
draw_nose      - true/false for procedural triangle nose
nose_color     - color for procedural nose outline
